C0450.title: Guangzhou Police Bust New Credit Card Fraud Ring: Cards Cloned in 125 Seconds
C0450.summary: In June 2024, Guangzhou police arrested 12 suspects across Hainan, Fujian, Jiangxi, and other regions, dismantling a new credit card fraud syndicate integrating card re-encoding, fraudulent transactions, and disposal of stolen goods.
